articles.summary: Instrumentl's ChatGPT plugin uses Model Context Protocol (MCP) to bring your real, vetted grant matches and saved pipeline from Instrumentl into ChatGPT. Surface your highest-priority matches, compare funders, cross-reference your strategic plan, and stay ahead of internal deadlines — working from your actual data, not a generic search. Available now to all Instrumentl customers.
articles.title: Bring Your Grant Data Into ChatGPT: Instrumentl's New MCP Plugin
